_doc: What people say (core/deals/deals_talk.gd). A line is picked by a hash of (world seed, person, game day, hour band), never by the sim's generator. Placeholders: {town} the settlement, {name} the speaker's given name, {faction}, {foe} a faction at war with this one, {dest} where a due caravan comes from. greet: by role. time: morning 5-11, day 11-17, evening 17-21, night 21-5. situation: from the sim (hungry, prosperous, war, raided, besieged, caravan_due, quiet); the first that applies is used, in this order. culture: an extra word now and then (one in three). knows: chronicle event kinds a role passes on as rumours ('*' = all). rumour_none: when nothing is known. offers: the labels of the options.

keeper: Mind the step. Everyone trips on it once.
You look like someone with questions.
Sit if you like. The stool wobbles; that's its job.
Ah. A face I don't owe money to.
merchant: Looking costs nothing. Touching costs a little.
Everything here is honest. The prices less so.
Buying or selling? Both is also allowed.
smith: Don't stand there. The sparks bite.
If it's sharp, I made it. If it's blunt, someone else did.
You're holding that blade wrong. Everyone does.
priest: The gods listen. They rarely reply.
Come in out of the weather, whatever it is today.
Hurt? Most people who come in here are.
guard: Keep your hands where I like them.
Move along. Or don't; just don't make trouble.
Quiet watch. Let's keep it that way.
townsfolk: Fine weather for it, whatever it is.
Don't ask me, I only live here.
escort: Keep pace or keep out of the way.
drover: The ox doesn't like you. The ox doesn't like anyone.
Wheels hold, we arrive. That's the whole plan.
migrant: We're just passing. Everyone is, eventually.

morning: The day's barely started and already it's long.
day: Middle of the day; middle of everything.
evening: Getting dark. The lamps go on soon.
night: Night. Most sensible people are asleep.
Keep to the lamps after dark.

besieged: There's an army at the walls. You noticed?
Nobody gets in or out. Except you, apparently.
raided: We buried people this month. Don't ask who.
Raiders came through. We're counting what's left.
The walls held. Mostly. The fences didn't.
war: We're at war with {foe}. Nobody asked me.
War with {foe}. Good for smiths, bad for everyone else.
Watch the roads; {foe} watches them too.
hungry: The granary echoes. That's never a good sound.
People are eating things I won't mention.
caravan_due: A caravan's due from {dest}. Everyone's suddenly my friend.
Wagons coming from {dest}, they say. We'll see.
prosperous: Good year. Don't tell the tax man.
Full barns, full purses. It won't last; enjoy it.
Money's about. Some of it might even land here.
quiet: Nothing happens here. We like it that way.
Quiet. Too quiet, my aunt says; she says that about everything.
Same as yesterday. Probably same as tomorrow.

elf: Seasons come and go. So do visitors.
halfling: Have you eaten? You look like you haven't.
Second breakfast is a right, not a privilege.
gnome: Don't touch the thing. The other thing either.
orc: You are small but you walk like a fighter.
dragonborn: Honour the clan, honour the deal.
tiefling: Stare all you like. Everyone does.
drow: Light is for those with nothing to hide.
Speak quietly. The dark is listening.
goblinoid: Boss says be nice. I'm being nice.
bandit: You didn't see me. Nobody does.

keeper: You hear things behind a bar. For instance:
merchant: Prices tell you everything, if you listen:
smith: Folk talk while they wait for a blade:
priest: The ones who come to pray say:

rumour_stale: Nothing new. The old talk, if you want it:
Nothing lately. Folk still go on about this:
rumour_none: Quiet lately. I'll make something up if you like.
Ask me again when something happens.

offers.bed: A bed for the night ({price} coin).
offers.bed_free: A bed for the night (on the house).

closing.hostile: They will not speak to you.
